title: Small RNA Sequencing (Mouse Blood)
author: Dain Lee
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Polyadenylate input RNA
steps.instruction: Polyadenylate the isolated RNA to create a priming sequence for the oligo-(dT) primer.

steps.title: Synthesize first‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform first‑strand cDNA synthesis using the 3’ smRNA dT Primer, which adds an adapter sequence to the 5’ end of each cDNA molecule, employing PrimeScript™ Reverse Transcriptase (cat no 2680, Takara Bio, Otsu, Japan).

steps.title: Template‑switch and add second adapter
steps.instruction: Allow PrimeScript RT to reach the 5’ end of each RNA template, add nontemplated nucleotides, and bind the SMART smRNA Oligo (enhanced with locked nucleic acid technology) which serves as a template for adding a second adapter sequence to the 3’ end of each first‑strand cDNA molecule.

steps.title: PCR amplify with Illumina adapters
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA library by PCR using the Forward PCR Primer (binds the SMART smRNA Oligo sequence) and the Reverse PCR Primer (binds the 3’ smRNA dT Primer sequence), thereby incorporating full‑length Illumina adapters and index sequences for sample multiplexing.

steps.title: Validate library quality
steps.instruction: Assess library size, purity, and concentration using an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Pool libraries equimolarly
steps.instruction: Combine the validated libraries in equimolar amounts.

steps.title: Sequence on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the pooled library onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument for sequencing.

steps.title: Process sequencing data
steps.instruction: Perform image decomposition and calculate quality values using Illumina pipeline modules provided by Macrogen, Inc. (Daejeon, South Korea).
